# Description

Please include a summary of the change and which bug is fixed. Please also include relevant motivation and context.
List any dependencies that are required for this change.

## Type of change

<!-- Please delete options that are not relevant -->

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

# Checklist:

- [ ] This pull request targets `integration`
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have documented the new public items (rustdoc)
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] `just ci` passes locally
- [ ] I have updated `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] To release: I have bumped `version` in `Cargo.toml` (patch / minor / major, checked by the semver job)
